title: Efficiency: provider list iteration on every ioctl_init is O(N*M)
description: crypto2dev_registry.c — crypto2dev_lookup_algo iterates the provider_list (providers * algos-per-provider). Currently wolfssl_provider registers 10 algorithms. With one provider the list walk is trivially short. The concern threshold is 200+ entries, which would require 20+ providers each with 10 algorithms, or one provider with 200 algorithms. The current wolfssl-only deployment has 10 entries. A future scenario with wolfssl + kcapi + hwaccel might reach 30-50 entries but is unlikely to reach 200. Per the task instructions, only flag if a realistic path to 200+ entries exists — it does not at this time. Not a real issue at current scale.
close_reason: Confirmed not a real issue at current scale: 10-50 entries, 200+ threshold not realistic
